examples.en: The prisoner tried to escape.
He escaped from the camp at night.
examples.zh: 他夜里从营地逃了出来。

examples.en: The guard was standing at the gate.
The prisoner killed the guard.
The prisoner of war wanted to escape.
The prisoner was put in prison.
examples.zh: 那名囚犯被关进了监狱。

examples.en: He dragged the heavy box into the room.
examples.zh: 他把那个沉重的箱子拖进了房间。

examples.en: He hid himself in the bushes.
The officer was wearing a blue uniform.
examples.zh: 那名军官穿着一身蓝制服。

examples.en: He carried a rifle over his shoulder.
The soldiers marched up and down.
He marched boldly in front of the camp.
examples.zh: 他大胆地在营地前面来回走着。

examples.en: The lights were blazing in the camp.
The prisoners lived in a camp.
examples.zh: 战俘们住在一座营地里。

examples.en: Four officers got out of the car.
examples.zh: 四名军官从车里走了出来。

examples.en: The prisoner stood to attention.
Pay attention to the teacher.
The soldier saluted the officer.
The driver of the car came towards him.
They discovered that a prisoner had escaped.
examples.zh: 他们发现一名战俘逃跑了。

sentences.en: He could hear shouting in the camp itself.
sentences.zh: 他能听见营地里的喊叫声。

sentences.en: Lights were blazing and men were running here and there.
sentences.zh: 灯火通明，人们在营地里东奔西跑。

sentences.en: They had just discovered that a prisoner had escaped.
sentences.zh: 他们刚刚发现一名战俘逃跑了。

sentences.en: At that moment, a large black car with four officers inside it stopped at the camp gates.
sentences.zh: 就在这时，一辆载着四名军官的黑色大轿车在营地门口停了下来。

sentences.en: The man obviously wanted to talk.
sentences.zh: 那人显然想跟他谈一谈。

article.en: When he had killed the guard, the prisoner of war quickly dragged him into the bushes.
article.zh: 当他杀死卫兵后，那名战俘迅速把他拖进了灌木丛。

article.en: Working rapidly in the darkness, he soon changed into the dead man's clothes.
article.zh: 他在黑暗中飞快地干着，很快就换上了死者的衣服。

article.en: Now, dressed in a blue uniform and with a rifle over his shoulder, the prisoner marched boldly up and down in front of the camp.
article.zh: 此时，那战俘身穿蓝制服，肩扛步枪，大胆地在营地前面来回走着。

article.en: He could hear shouting in the camp itself.
article.zh: 他能听见营地里的喊叫声。

article.en: Lights were blazing and men were running here and there.
article.zh: 灯火通明，人们在营地里东奔西跑。

article.en: They had just discovered that a prisoner had escaped.
article.zh: 他们刚刚发现一名战俘逃跑了。

article.en: At that moment, a large black car with four officers inside it stopped at the camp gates.
article.zh: 就在这时，一辆载着四名军官的黑色大轿车在营地门口停了下来。

article.en: The officers got out and the prisoner stood to attention and saluted as they passed.
article.zh: 军官们下了车，那名战俘在他们经过时立正敬礼。

article.en: When they had gone, the driver of the car came towards him.
article.zh: 他们走后，汽车司机朝他走来。

article.en: The man obviously wanted to talk.
article.zh: 那人显然想跟他谈一谈。
